summary: Typosquat of python-bitcoinlib exfiltrates installer credentials and wallet keys to webhook.site
details: npm package python-bitcoinlib@1.0.3 is a typosquat of the legitimate PyPI library of the same name. On require(), index.js reads installer-owned secrets from the home directory (.env, ~/.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa and related private keys, ~/.config/solana/id.json and other Solana/Ethereum keystores) and recursively scans dotfolders for filenames containing wallet, key, secret, seed, mnemonic, keystore, or private, then POSTs the collected contents over HTTPS to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint (path /5c5ad6cb-62df-4ea5-9dfb-2c447920ddc4). Host and user identity (os.hostname(), os.userInfo()) are included in the payload. The payload is gated behind a hardcoded activation timestamp (Date.UTC(2026,7,6)) so that require() is a no-op until that date, delaying detection by registry sandboxes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
